after.rosterkit/seating.py:
# owner: platform
"""Seating charts: students sorted by last name, in rows."""

from typing import List

from rosterkit.models import Student


def format_row(number: int, members: List[Student]) -> str:
    names = " | ".join(item.display_name for item in members)
    return f"Row {number}: {names}"


# ---
def seating_rows(students, seats_per_row: int) -> List[str]:
    """Return one line of text per row of seats."""
    if seats_per_row <= 0:
        raise ValueError("seats_per_row must be positive")
    if not students:
        raise ValueError("no students to seat")
    key = lambda item: (item.last_name, item.first_name)
    ordered = sorted(students, key=key)
    size = seats_per_row
    return [
        format_row(index // size + 1, ordered[index:index + size])
        for index in range(0, len(ordered), size)
    ]
